description: This source file defines a React component for a web page that allows users to upload professional documents (resume, job description, performance review), connect LinkedIn, and proceed to generate a career persona. It manages state for uploaded files and connection status, provides UI components for file upload and display, and includes logic to handle document selection, removal, and validation before proceeding.

classes.name: SuccessFileCard
classes.description: A React component that displays a successfully uploaded document with options to remove it.

classes.name: UploadCard
classes.description: A React component that provides UI for uploading a document of a specific kind and showing its upload status.

methods.name: kindLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a document type (resume, job description, performance review).

methods.name: kindHelp
methods.description: Provides guidance/help text for the specific document type.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string (B, KB, MB).

methods.name: upsertDoc
methods.description: Adds or updates a document of a specific type, updating the flow state accordingly.

methods.name: removeKind
methods.description: Removes a document of a specific type from the flow state.
